title: Privacy, in plain words
short: The short version: your stuff stays on your phone. We don't want your name, address, or photos, and we never sell anything.
s1: Your profile (grade, interests, goals), saved opportunities, plans, chats, hours and everything else you add is saved only on this device, in your browser's storage. It is not uploaded to our server. If you delete the app's data or use “Delete my data,” it's gone.
s2: Your full name, home address, phone number, email, photos, or social media. A nickname is optional and stays on your device — unless you post in People, tell classmates you're going to an event, or share activity with your school. Then only your nickname is shown.
s3: When you search or chat with the Coach, your message plus a few profile details (grade, age, interests, goals, how you get around, and your town) are sent to our server and then to the AI company that runs Rumbo's AI: Anthropic (Claude) or, on the free setup, Groq. Your nickname is never sent. Our server does not keep your chats. These companies' rules for business (API) customers say they do not use these requests to train their AI.
s4: To keep costs low and the app safe, our server keeps: copies of search results for 24 hours (so repeat searches are free), a count of how many AI requests were made today (stored with a scrambled device code and a scrambled version of your internet address — scrambled with a secret key, so the real ones are never saved), and anything you choose to share: posts in moderated groups, reviews, shared plans, event check-ins, parent share links (they expire after 60 days), activity counts you share with your school, and anonymous counts (like “12 students near 785 saved this”).
s5: If you're under 13, a parent or guardian must agree before you use Rumbo (this follows COPPA, a U.S. law that protects kids online). Parents can lock features with a PIN and delete everything at any time.
s6: There is no private messaging. Groups are moderated. Phone numbers, emails, addresses and social media handles are removed automatically from posts. School groups need a code from a teacher, parent, or school.
s7: You can download all your data or delete it from Me → Download or delete my data. Deleting removes everything from this device right away, plus your posts, reviews, shared plans, parent links and school activity counts from our server.
s8: Ask a parent, teacher, or school counselor to help, or contact the student developer through the project's GitHub page.
